pr_title: Fix alexa calling not featured cover services
pr_body:

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.

Fix alexa calling `cover.open_cover` and `cover.cover_close` if not supported but `cover.set_cover_position` is supported. In that case `cover.set_cover_position` should be called instead.

Fix alexa calling `cover.open_cover_tilt` and `cover.close_cover_tilt` if not supported but `cover.set_cover_tilt_position` is supported. In that case `cover.set_cover_tilt_position` should be called instead.

issue_context.title: Alexa integration (via HA Online) can't set cover Tilt to values 0 and 100
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I have venetian blinds integrated with HA via Overkiz Local API integration (a day ago Homekit integration - but it didn't work with that one either so I don't think it's related). They got position and tilt control.

I got Alexa integrated with HA via HA Cloud and these covers are imported into it. 

In HA everything works as expected - setting Position or Tilt always produces the expected result (any value).

However, I noticed weeks if not months ago that Alexa stopped responding to "Alexa close XYZ Blinds". It used to work though (but maybe that was before I switched from VELUX integration months back).

Now I experimented a little and to my surprise, setting Tilt (and only Tilt - because Position works fine) to values 0 or 100 causes no action. However, any value in between works - both through Alexa app or by issuing a voice command. Thus, it feels like a bug in the integration. Error seems to be produced - attaching. 

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.12.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Amazon Alexa

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/alexa/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

[alexa source](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/tree/dev/homeassistant/components/alexa)
<sub><sup>(message by IssueLinks)</sup></sub>

Looking at the error message, it appears that the integration attempts to use services `cover.close_cover_tilt` and `cover.open_cover_tilt` when setting tilt to positions `0` or `100`.

However, the entity does not advertise these services to be available - see the screenshot below and the definition of [CoverEntityFeature](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/1eaf208450e43551485380d54828d51663f99b7b/homeassistant/components/cover/__init__.py#L87) - 143 = everything **but** OPEN_TILT, CLOSE_TILT, STOP_TILT
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/3817903/c9d86cf5-6348-413b-8cac-12ad10ca628f)

i.e. Alexa integration probably does not check the availability of the feature before using it
in this case it should simply always use `cover.set_cover_tilt_position`

or, alternatively (or in addition), Overkiz integration should be updated to make these features available since technically it can deliver it.
Thanx for reporting, I hope to have a look at it soon.
